en: Record revenue of ₩104.6 trillion (+328%) and operating profit of ₩83.3 trillion (+632%, an 80% margin) beat consensus of about ₩98 trillion and ₩77 trillion, as DRAM prices rose by a high-20s % and HBM4 went into full shipment. Net profit of ₩39.8 trillion trailed forecasts on currency and investment losses. CFO Kim Woo-hyun guided Q4 DRAM bits up mid-20% and NAND up mid-single digits, said LTAs with 14 customers cover over half of 2027–28 capacity, and set about ₩100 trillion of 2026 shareholder returns.

The results came out before the Seoul open on Oct 28, after the Oct 27 US close of $145.36. Seoul shares closed up 10.9%, lifting the KOSPI 6.6% back above 6,000, and the Nasdaq ADS then jumped 13.3% to $164.70 on about twice normal volume, back above its $149 listing price; Micron rose 5.9%. Investors focused on the record 80% margin, an extra ₩60 trillion of shareholder returns and management's view that memory supply stays short through 2030.
zh: 营收创纪录达 104.6 万亿韩元（+328%），营业利润 83.3 万亿韩元（+632%，利润率 80%），超过约 98 万亿和 77 万亿韩元的市场预期；DRAM 价格环比上涨近 30%，HBM4 全面出货。受汇兑与投资损失影响，净利润 39.8 万亿韩元低于预期。CFO 金宇贤指引 Q4 DRAM 出货量环比增约 25%、NAND 增中个位数，与 14 家客户的长期协议覆盖 2027–28 年过半产能，并定下 2026 年约 100 万亿韩元的股东回报。

业绩于 10 月 28 日首尔开盘前公布，此前美股 10 月 27 日收于 145.36 美元。首尔股价收涨 10.9%，带动 KOSPI 上涨 6.6%，重返 6,000 点上方；随后纳斯达克 ADS 大涨 13.3% 至 164.70 美元，成交量约为平日两倍，重回 149 美元上市价上方；美光上涨 5.9%。投资者关注创纪录的 80% 利润率、追加 60 万亿韩元的股东回报，以及管理层认为内存供应短缺将持续至 2030 年。

bio.en: Joined Hyundai Electronics, SK hynix's predecessor, as a process engineer and rose through manufacturing technology and safety. Co-CEO from 2022 and sole CEO since late 2023, he oversaw the HBM3 and HBM3E ramps that made SK hynix NVIDIA's main memory supplier.
bio.zh: 以工艺研发人员身份加入 SK 海力士前身现代电子，历任制造技术与安全负责人。2022 年任联席 CEO，2023 年底起独任 CEO，主导 HBM3 与 HBM3E 量产，使 SK 海力士成为英伟达的主要内存供应商。

bio.en: Vice president, CFO and head of finance. A finance specialist who came up through SK Group affiliates; handled the SEC review for the record $26.5B US ADS listing in July 2026 and now manages a net cash pile of ₩98.7 trillion at the end of September.
bio.zh: 副社长、CFO 兼财务负责人。出身 SK 集团各关联公司的财务专家，负责 2026 年 7 月创纪录的 265 亿美元美国 ADS 上市的美国证交会审核事宜，目前管理截至 9 月底 98.7 万亿韩元的净现金。
